run_symbolic_regression_evaluation: run the evaluation script on a symbolic regression problem directory to compute train, test, and OOD metrics
compute_base_metrics: compute MSE, NMSE, R2, Kendall tau, and MAPE metrics between predicted and actual numpy arrays
optimize_model_parameters: optimize model parameters using BFGS minimization on training data with multiple random restart attempts
load_and_evaluate_program: load a best_program.py model file and evaluate it against training, test, and OOD datasets
encode_numpy_json: serialize numpy integers, floats, and arrays into valid JSON using a custom JSON encoder class
